message.content: {"reading": {"line": "Changing your surroundings shapes your habits more reliably than sheer effort ever will.", "options": [{"move": "the test", "note": "If environment really trumps willpower, then people who structure their spaces for success should see lasting behavior change even when their motivation fluctuates."}, {"move": "the boundary", "note": "Environment design works best for habits with clear physical cues—internal habits like thought patterns resist this approach."}, {"move": "the cost", "note": "Relying on environment design can make you dependent on external cues, so when the setting changes, the habit may fall apart."}], "pick": 0}, "insights": [{"index":0,"move":"first of its kind","headline":"Nothing else you’ve saved under psychology takes environment design as the main lever for behavior change."}]}
